clues.it: Rosa era l'unica seduta su una poltrona.
clues.en: Rosa was the only one sitting on a flight seat.

clues.it: Bruno era a nord di Carla.
Carla era da sola in Serra.
clues.en: Carla was alone in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Nino era accanto a una vasca idroponica o a un serbatoio.
clues.en: Nino was beside a hydroponic tank or a fuel tank.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a una grata.
clues.en: Luca was beside a floor grate.

clues.it: Fabio era accanto a un droide.
Sergio era da solo nella Sala Macchine.
clues.en: Sergio was alone in the Engine Room.

steps.it: L'indizio di Rosa lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Rosa's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 8th.

steps.it: Solo Bruno può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 5ª è sua.
steps.en: Bruno is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 5th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Carla più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Carla's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 3rd, column 4th.

steps.it: Solo Nino può stare nella 4ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 6ª è sua.
steps.en: Nino is the only one who can be in the 4th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 6th is theirs.

steps.en: Anna is the only one who can be in the 5th row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 7th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca più le righe e le colonne già occupate lasciano una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Luca's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 6th, column 2nd.

steps.en: Sergio's clue plus the rows and columns already taken leave a single square: row 8th, column 1st.
